title: Gate-triggered exact-command cooldown
cohort: same independent matched cohort as ASTIG-012A/B: 10 SWE-bench tasks x 3 models
normalization: lowercase + whitespace normalization only; command arguments/paths/content retained
gate: ASTIG-012A default: W=8, warning R_cmd>=0.25, strong if R_cmd>=0.50 for 2 consecutive windows or >=0.75 once, minimum 6 observed commands
cooldown_rule: after strong-loop gate is active, current exact normalized command loses execution eligibility if it appeared in previous h commands
interpretation: short-cycle command recurrence, not generic action repetition, is the target; h=4 captures immediate and ABAB/ABCABC-style loops while the regime gate prevents normal-work interference
evidence_scope: Recorded-edge interception diagnostic on observed trajectories; the measured outcome is recurrence-edge interception.
